notes: estate-crucible Batch Badlands (#7065, BDLD): BDLDCKP, the I-O-CONTROL RERUN program refused at the level's first-time translate (2026-11-04, LayoutError; read since #8577), as BDLDCKJ step CKP010 runs it, on 1203 GENERATED TRAN-REC records (the BDLREC layout), past the RERUN ON SYSCKPT EVERY 1000 RECORDS interval. Its output is the DISPLAY of the record count (the job log). RERUN writes checkpoints for a restart; neither the oracle (GnuCOBOL) nor the port takes them, and no output of the step depends on them. The oracle is GnuCOBOL, not z/OS.
